answer: Ask every agent each epoch for a fresh piece of writing on a seeded prompt, then compare all entries for hidden overlap. A farm of fake agents usually pulls from one model and one prompt, so its answers share a single thread of phrasing, like a sonnet copied with a few words swapped. Peers flag those clusters, and the whole cluster splits one reward. Like a willow that bends but keeps one root, the farm can spawn many names yet still earns as one.
